entries.what: Rode the 7:02 Tule Line from Flats Junction with a large masala chai from Anh's cart, then sat through his MWF morning classes at Bayshore State.
entries.outcome: Made it to class on time.

entries.what: Submitted application number 81 at the career center front desk between shifts tasks and updated the spreadsheet, color-coding rows by stage. Called it another message in a bottle.
Late night tweaking resume bullets again, music on, past 1 a.m.
Took the 7:02 north and attended Dr. Ashby's 10:30 operations management class.
Sent his one LinkedIn alum message of the day from the library, then ate a rajma container for lunch.
Evening at the Marisol Gardens apartment, quietly left leftovers out for Marcus before his night shift.
entries.outcome: Marcus grabbed them on his way out.

entries.what: MWF classes at Bayshore, after a train ride on the 7:02.
Worked his ten-hour-a-week front desk shift at the career center and rehearsed in his head how to ask Ashby for a letter.
entries.outcome: Decided to ask Thursday at office hours.

entries.what: Edited his resume at night and added a few applications.
Tue/Thu class with Dr. Ashby at 10:30, then waited outside his door during Thursday 2-3:30 office hours and knocked anyway.
entries.outcome: Asked Ashby for a recommendation letter; he said he would think about it.

entries.what: Rode the train home and did laundry in the card-only laundry room at Marisol Gardens that night.
Updated the spreadsheet with a note about Ashby's letter status.
Took the 7:02 to campus for MWF classes and picked up chai from Anh's cart beforehand, paying on his weekly tab.
Afternoon at the career center desk, then case competition team meeting to split work for the Nov 8 event.
entries.outcome: Got his slice of the analysis.

entries.what: Evening at home with Marcus before his shift, grocery run to Ruiz Family Market.
Ran the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop, about 4 miles, Saturday morning.
Picked up his phone from the Plaza Marisol repair shop with a new $65 battery.
Spent the evening on resume and applications, with bhangra on.
entries.outcome: A few more rows filled in.

entries.what: Went to his parents' Pell Road house for Sunday dinner, and visited the Delgado Park harvest farmers market for fruit and peppers with his mom.
entries.outcome: Came home with a tub of dal.

entries.what: Took the Sunday call from his mother about internships, answering about the 81 applications and Ashby's letter.
Meal-prepped four containers of rajma and rice.
